title: Why Your Friend Quits After Their First Game

scenes.title: 첫 한 판을 지키는 설계
lines: The kart rounds a corner and continues down the track. For an experienced player, this is ordinary. For someone new, keeping the race going under their own control can already be a small success. Why might a friend quit before reaching the fun? We will agree on a shared goal, ease the first controls, and leave room for personal choices, in that order.
Being kind to beginners protects their chance to try, recognize the result, and want another attempt. Two people can enter the same race expecting different first experiences.

scenes.title: 상대의 목적은 화면에 없다
lines: Imagine starting Mario Kart with a friend who has never played before. The race is about following the course and reaching the finish ahead of the others. The experienced player immediately looks for ways to pull ahead. Their friend is still finding the button that makes the kart move and learning how far to steer at a corner.

The experienced player feels successful when their position improves. For their friend, avoiding the wall and making the kart turn as intended may already be an achievement. One person can reach the finish while the other ends the first race without knowing what their own controls accomplished.

One person came to test their skill; the other simply thought it looked fun and wanted a try. They share a race but have different intentions. If your friend is struggling just to move forward, pause before explaining another fast shortcut and agree on what they want to try.

scenes.title: 전력 승부에도 전제가 있다
lines: If your friend asks for a serious race, honor that agreement and compete. They may not want you to lose deliberately. The etiquette of an all-out contest assumes that both people want one.

For a casual first try, agree on a smaller goal. Instead of the finishing position, first make it around one corner, then try using an item. Instead of adding everything they need to master at once, leave one achievable action.

After explaining steering, let your friend try the input. The kart turns, clears the corner, and reveals the road ahead. Their action connects to a visible result. They can try the next corner themselves. That small success offered by another person can also be built into a game’s opening experience.

scenes.title: 첫 조작에서 재미까지
lines: A new player still has many unknowns. The buttons and screen indicators are unfamiliar, along with what to do right now. Onboarding eases that burden between first contact and a first taste of the fun.

This matters in competitive and single-player games alike. If fun begins only after every control has been memorized, people may leave before reaching it. Let them try one action first, show its result, then add the next action.

Mario Kart 8 Deluxe combines acceleration, steering, and items in a race. Following a corner may already occupy a newcomer’s attention. Several simultaneous inputs leave less room to understand the race. Some of that burden can be selectively reduced.

scenes.title: 보조는 선택을 남긴다
lines: Smart Steering helps steer when the kart is about to leave the course around a corner. Enabling it adds an antenna to the back of the kart. Auto-Accelerate keeps it moving without holding the acceleration button. These options handle different burdens.

Reducing the need to hold acceleration leaves more attention for corners and items. Steering assistance lets someone begin by developing a feel for the track. Rather than removing every action, it creates room to focus on what they are learning.

The player can turn assistance off as they become comfortable. The game lets you hold a sideways slide through a corner, called a drift, and release the built-up charge for a brief Mini-Turbo boost. While Smart Steering is enabled, the third stage, Ultra Mini-Turbo, is unavailable. The design widens the entrance while leaving room to learn more precise control.

scenes.title: 조작은 가볍게, 선택은 직접
lines: Easing a burden does not always require an assistance option. Unpacking is about taking possessions out of moving boxes and finding places for them in a new home. Take out an item, choose a place, and set it down. A familiar act of tidying connects directly to the task in the game.

The game does not require holding buttons or pressing several buttons at once. There is no time limit, so slower hands do not have to hurry. You can move an item again after placing it, learning the controls and arrangement at your own pace.

The player still chooses what goes where. Reducing the control burden leaves room for personal taste and judgment. A designer can likewise separate what to ease from what the player should decide. If the person beside them dictates every placement, another problem appears.

scenes.title: 끌고 가면 발견이 사라진다
lines: Constant instructions about the next button, path, and action may reduce mistakes. They also reduce opportunities to choose. A helpful beginning can become carrying out another person’s sequence.

In A Short Hike, a small bird walks around an island, climbs surfaces, and glides from heights. Following an uphill path can lead to gliding toward a place that catches the eye. Choosing where to go within the visible landscape, then moving and seeing the result, is part of exploration’s pleasure.

Announcing every shortcut and destination in advance takes away the feeling of discovery. Explain controls and rules when needed, and leave space for the person to choose the next action. Knowing when to step back matters alongside how much help to provide.

scenes.title: 작은 관심을 다음 한 판으로
lines: Getting someone interested enough to try a game is already difficult. That small opening need not end in a first round they never understood or a stream of instructions. Help the first willingness to try become another attempt.
Agree on a shared goal, ease the first controls, and return decisions as confidence grows. The newcomer can then reach for another try by choice, because of a result they discovered themselves.
People play games to enjoy themselves. Open a path that lets someone reach that enjoyment under their own power. Kindness to beginners protects their choice to play the next game.
